name: Falkland Islands (1925–1948)
description: A British Blue Ensign with the Union Flag in the canton and the colonial badge of the Falkland Islands, a shield with a sailing ship and a sea lion beneath the motto 'Desire the Right', in the fly.
history: Blue Ensign of the Falkland Islands with the badge granted in 1925, showing the ship Desire, in which John Davis sighted the islands in 1592, and a sea lion. It was replaced in 1948 when the colony's coat of arms was placed on a white disc.

features.role: colonial badge with ship and sea lion
